wa_a_great_northern_slab_gorilla_my_drea.notes: MISFILED (catalog defect, report only): Gorilla My Dreams is NOT on the Great Northern Slab. Mountain Project files it under Middle Town Walls > Winkie Dinkie Cliff, and the Index guide (rakkup) files it under The Lower Town Walls > Winkie Dinkie Cliff. Winkie Dinkie sits directly ABOVE GNS (reached by any GNS route or Dr. Sniff, then up and slightly west). The catalog already has an area wa_winkie_dinkie_cliff (parent wa_middle_town_walls, 47.81891,-121.5723) holding no Gorilla row, so this row should probably move there; no duplicate row exists. It is not a pitch or variation of Great Northern Slab or Aries: a bolted lieback flake in the middle of Winkie Dinkie, its own route in both publishers. Access is still the Godzilla object: the State Parks layer and the county parcel put Winkie Dinkie inside Forks of the Sky (same parcel 10030000000400). pitches stays null (no count stated). SAFETY: a 2008 MP comment reports a climber who fell from the first bolt and was flown out; gear low (a #3 before the first bolt) when wet. The MP area page asks climbers not to knock anything onto the busy GNS below. ROCKFALL CHECK (brief AJ): the 29 Nov 2023 rockfall is confirmed in the MP forum thread 'Index rockfall' (Nov 29 2023 - Feb 8 2024): debris and trees came off the top of the Great Northern Slab and raked it top to base, the trail from before the toilet to Roger's Corner was taped off (tape still up Dec 17 2023), on Jan 7 2024 GNS and the Roger's Corner area were reported not climbable, GNS was reported not destroyed (some big trees gone, no bolts known damaged), and a Feb 8 2024 post placed the START of the slide at Winkie Dinkie Cliff, directly above GNS. The thread names none of the aj1 lines. Winkie Dinkie is where that Feb 2024 post put the start of the slide, but Gorilla My Dreams has MP comments from Jul 28 2024, Aug 4 2024 (gear beta) and Sep 2 2025 describing it climbed, so it was not lost. No source says its bolts or anchor changed.

wa_a_great_northern_slab_snow_white.notes: MISFILED + SUPERSEDED (clean-up candidate, owner call). Snow White is NOT on the Great Northern Slab: it is on the Main Wall at the start of Princely Ambitions, in MP's 'Dwarf Tossing to Narrow Arrow' area (catalog: wa_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow). MP has no Snow White page. How the rows relate: (1) Dwarf Tossing to Narrow Arrow (wa_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow; MP 5.12b, 100 ft, FFA James Wyland 2001) is, per MP, essentially the free variation of Snow White's first pitch (the original took the thin crack from the Princely Ambitions start straight to the mini roof at the 3rd bolt); the guide lists it as 'Snow White / Dwarf Tossing' 5.12b, formerly Snow White, a 2-pitch route. (2) NTAD / Nobody Tosses A Dwarf (MP 5.12, 110 ft, Ben Gilkison & Ryan Daudistel, freed 2014 per the guide) starts from a bolted chain anchor about 2/3 up Princely Ambitions P1 and, per MP, roughly half of it is terrain from the ORIGINAL second (aid) pitch of Snow White; it ends at Tadpole's anchor. So NTAD is a free version of part of Snow White P2, not of the whole route. DUPLICATE to report: wa_ntad_free_var_to_snow_white (Main Wall left side, 5.12c/d, 34 m, same FA) and wa_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow_nobody_tosses_a_dwarf (5.12, 34 m) are the same line, NTAD; the keeper is likely the latter (MP name and area). The stored 5.12c/d on the NTAD row matches neither MP (5.12) nor the guide (5.12). Access uses the Godzilla object, which is the Main Wall's own (Godzilla is in the same MP area). ROCKFALL: the 2023 rockfall thread mentions only debris over the trail near Roger's Corner / Princely Ambitions, not damage to these lines.
